d.why: On screen only in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. 'Window of Opportunity' (mentioned elsewhere), where he is the villain of Fitz's storyline and the employer who keeps Fitz and Enoch (both filed) as unpaid labour before Fitz tricks him out of the airlock.
On screen in two Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episodes, 'All the Comforts of Home' and 'The Real Deal' (only mentioned in a deleted scene of 'The End').
Only in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. 'One of Us', where he is one of Cal's recruits, hacking the Index and the school's systems in Cal's plot until Coulson knocks him out.

On screen only in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. 'The Patriot' (a photo in 'Hot Potato Soup'), where he is the Watchdogs' hired assassin whose attempt on Director Mace drives the episode until Daisy catches him.
Only in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. 'Laws of Nature', a Moroccan relic broker in one scene of Fitz's search for Simmons, tricked out of the scroll casing with a flash grenade.
On screen in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episodes 5x02 and 5x03 (only mentioned in 5x04 and 5x06).
On screen in Daredevil episodes 1x06, 1x12 and 1x13 (mentioned in 1x10 and 3x03).
Only in Daredevil 'Into the Ring' (mentioned later), an indebted cop Wesley forces to try strangling Karen in her cell; Rance is the episode's killer, and Farnum's daughter Tracy has no file.
On screen in three Daredevil episodes: 'World on Fire', 'Condemned' and 'Daredevil'.
On screen in Daredevil 1x03, 1x10, 1x12 and 1x13 (photos in season 2), and she is Ben Urich's wife.
Only in Daredevil 'Stick' (mentioned or pictured later), a Westmeyer-Holt thug who jumps Karen in an alley until Foggy hits him with a bat.
On screen in Daredevil 1x08 (flashbacks), 1x10 and 1x12, plus a voice role in Echo, and she is Wilson Fisk's mother.
Only in Daredevil 'Rabbit in a Snowstorm', the widow of Daniel Fisher (who has no file) in one scene warning Karen to drop Union Allied.
On screen only in Daredevil 'World on Fire' (mentioned in two others), a Russian mobster who is caught, names Fisk to the detectives and is shot by Blake, a side beat in Fisk's war on the Russians.
On screen only in Daredevil 'Rabbit in a Snowstorm' (mentioned elsewhere), where he is the murder victim whose killing by John Healy is the case Matt and Foggy defend in the episode.
On screen only in Daredevil 'Into the Ring' (mentioned later), where he is the episode's on-screen villain, killing Daniel Fisher, framing Karen and attacking her for the flash drive.
On screen in two Daredevil episodes, 'Cut Man' and 'In the Blood'.
On screen in Daredevil 1x10 and 1x13 (mentioned in 1x09 and 1x12).
On screen in three Daredevil episodes: 'In the Blood', 'World on Fire' and 'Condemned'.
Only in Daredevil 'Cut Man' (his Born Again 'Gloves Off' flashback is archive footage), where he backs Sweeney in pressing Jack Murdock to throw the fight; Sweeney is the one who decides Jack's fate.
Only in Daredevil 'Stick' (mentioned or pictured later), a Westmeyer-Holt thug who jumps Karen in an alley and gets her pepper spray in his own eyes.
On screen in three Daredevil episodes: 'Regrets Only', 'Semper Fidelis' and 'Guilty as Sin'.
On screen in three Daredevil episodes, 'Seven Minutes in Heaven', 'The Man in the Box' and '.380', and he is Stan Gibson's son.
Only in Daredevil 'Seven Minutes in Heaven', where he is the Rikers boss Fisk sets Frank against; Frank goes after his crew, gets the Central Park deal from him, and he dies at the end.
On screen only in Daredevil 'Penny and Dime' (mentioned once later), a fired nurse in one scene telling Karen how the John Doe woke up and where he drove him.

Alive on screen only in Daredevil '.380' (just his corpse in the next episode), one of the Blacksmith's men who leads the pier ambush on Frank and dies in the ship explosion; Schoonover is the villain.
On screen in Daredevil 2x07 and 2x09 (a corpse in 2x10, mentioned in 2x11).
On screen in five Daredevil episodes: 2x05, 2x06, 2x09, 2x11 and 2x12.
On screen only in Daredevil 'The Man in the Box' (mentioned in '.380'), a Chaste assassin in one airport fight with Elektra who reveals Stick sent him, a side scene in the episode.
On screen in Daredevil 2x03, 2x06, 2x10 and 2x11 (mentioned in Luke Cage and Iron Fist).
